subject: Upcoming Company Event: Save the Date!
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming company event! Mark your calendars for Friday, October 15th, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an evening of celebration, team building activities, and delicious food. Formal invitations will follow soon. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, The Events Committee
